title: Principle 2: nothing depends on itself — dependence is on another
source_text: XII. Est etiam extra dubium, nihil pendere a seipso: sed quicquid dependet, ab alio dependere. Ratio manifesta est: nam si aliquid penderet a seipso, idem esset seipso prius & posterius. Quod enim dependet, posterius est eo unde dependet.
pass_a_gloss: It is also beyond doubt that nothing depends on itself: but whatever depends, depends on another. The reason is plain: for if something depended on itself, the same thing would be prior and posterior to itself. For what depends is posterior to that on which it depends.
pass_b_english: Second principle: nothing depends on itself.
Self-dependence would make the same thing prior and posterior to itself.
